syl: ᎯᎠᏃ ᏥᎩᎵᎵ ᏣᎧᏔᎮᎢ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎪᏍᏓᏱ ᏗᎦᏘᏍᏙᏗ ᎦᏰᏌᏗ ᎤᏕᎵᏍᏛᎢ
pho: hi'ahno tsigili:lí tsa:gtahé:'i sgina gó:sda:yi digálitisdóhdi gaye:sad(i) udé:lisdv'i

eng: her heart was not in her chest.
It was in the soft palm of her hand.

syl: ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᎯᎠ ᎠᏂᏃᏟᏙᎯ ᏰᎵ ᎤᏂᏲᏍᏙᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏐᏅᎢ ᏍᎩᎵ.
pho: sgiyvhno hí'a ani:nohlidóhi yéli uni:yó:sdohdi gesv´ hí'a u:so:nv´:'i sgi:lí.
eng: At last the hunters could destroy the evil witch.

syl: ᎠᎴ ᏗᎦᏟᏓ ᎤᏪᏘᎸᎩ ᏆᎾᎥᎢ ᎤᏬᏰᏂ ᏃᎴ ᏍᎩᏴᏃ ᏧᎵᏬᏤᎢ.
pho: ale digahltsida uwanilv'i gwaná:'v'i uwoyé:ni nole sgiyvhno tsulihwó:tse'i.
eng: An arrow struck her soft palm, and she died.

pho: ani:tsalagi tsiyú:gdi kanohé:sgi anosého:'i hí'a tsigili:lí.
eng: The Cherokees call the chickadee “truth teller.”
